items.name: gradient-hero
items.title: Gradient hero
items.description: A hero section with an animated, grainy gradient behind the headline, colored by your theme.
items.author: Hazeglow (https://hazeglow.dev)
items.docs:
Usage: <GradientHero title="Make it glow" description="Your pitch here."><Button size="lg">Get started</Button></GradientHero>
Colors come from --hazeglow-1 to --hazeglow-5, which this item adds to your CSS for light and dark. They default to Paper moon from the hazeglow.dev gallery; edit them to match your brand, and the gradient fades into --background. Live WebGL2 canvases: keep a few per page, since browsers allow about 16. Design your own look at https://hazeglow.dev/generator and paste its config.
